name: What factors determine the cost of interior restoration?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of interior restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely based on the square footage, materials specified, and whether structural components require rebuilding. Minor localized drywall and trim restoration costs substantially less than rebuilding a storm-damaged basement, a neglected bathroom, or a foreclosed property. Key cost drivers include the degree of demolition required, whether plumbing and electrical fixtures must be relocated or replaced, and the grade of replacement finishes, such as standard tile versus custom marble. Obtaining an on-site walkthrough allows a contractor to evaluate framing, subfloors, and finishes directly to provide an accurate, transparent scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the square footage affected, framing and subfloor repair needs, trade coordination, and the replacement finishes you select, such as custom tile or millwork.
